headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Brodie Lee vs. Cody battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.90 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 10 defenses. This stood as the 10th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. Cody was chasing gold for the 10th time. A shocking, total squash that stunned fans watching live ? Lee dominated Cody from bell to bell, ending his 91-day title reign in brutal fashion and stretchering him out, in a moment many still remember as one of the most jarring title changes in AEW history.

That Saturday in 2026, Daniel Garcia chalked up their 150th recorded AEW match ? a milestone worth celebrating, facing Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia on Collision, rated 8.06 ? an excellent showing in a hard-fought men's division clash.
On this day in 2020, Brandi Rhodes made their long-awaited return to AEW television after 7 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2026, back when Shawn Dean returned to the fold after 7 weeks away, appearing on Collision.
It was 2026 when Willow Nightingale vs. Maya World closed out Collision, rated 7.05 ? a match that delivered with the women's division on full display.
That Saturday in 2020, Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Five touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.83.
